title: Evaluate a gradient boosting pipeline
description: You inspect the fixed estimator settings and test-set regression metrics.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You place a scaler before GradientBoostingRegressor. The estimator requests 300 boosting stages with learning_rate=0.05.
You set max_depth=3, subsample=0.9, and random_state=42. These settings form a single configured pipeline.

steps.question: Which data fits the pipeline, and which data receives predictions?
steps.answer: fit receives X_train and y_train. predict receives X_test.

steps.description: You compare the test predictions with y_test. The recording reports R-squared and mean squared error.
